messages:
Nora: Heads up — legal found several docs/examples with realistic-looking PII. With the v1->v2 deprecation and model alias swap happening next month we need: a short migration guide, sanitized snippets (TS/py/curl), and a link audit.
Liam: On it. I'll run a quick grep for email/phone patterns and keys, then script replacements to <EMAIL>/<PHONE>/<REDACTED_KEY>. Will open small PRs with preview builds.
Chen: SDK note: embeddings API changes from `createEmbedding(dimension=...)` to `embeddings.create(vector_dim=...)`. Also responses moved from `models.generate` -> `responses.create`. I'll prepare side-by-side snippets.
Priya: Samples used in onboarding are priority. I'll update README examples and the quickstart model table (`open-quant-7b` -> `redwood-q-7b`). Add a deprecation banner on v1 pages linking to the migration guide.
Liam: Plan: 1) automated replace + report, 2) manual pass for false positives, 3) incremental PRs to avoid big merges. Branch: `docs/sanitize-2991`.
Chen: Snippet preview (doc copy):
```js
// v1
await client.models.generate({model: 'redwood-v1', input: 'Hello'})
// v2
await client.responses.create({model: 'redwood-v2', input: 'Hello'})
```
Priya: CI: the doc-runner currently expects v1 names. Can we add a small shim so smoke tests don't fail while PRs land?
Nora: Yes — add a transient v1->v2 adapter in the doc-runner. Ops-bot: queue a test run after PRs.
Liam: Assignments: Liam (sanitize script + PRs), Chen (snippets + migration guide draft), Priya (samples + table updates + redirects), Nora (legal sign-off + banners). Everyone drop PR links here when opened.
Chen: Draft changelog: "Deprecate v1 API. Migrate to responses.create and embeddings.create with vector_dim. See migration guide for examples and scripts."
Priya: Timeline: first PRs tomorrow morning, merge small batches by end of week, migration guide live and banners up next Friday.
Nora: Will coordinate legal review once the sanitize PRs are up. :thumbsup:
